criteria.statement: Only an opaque credential reference and the exact nine approved public Arcana VITE_* arguments cross the signed request.
Bahia validates service and credential ownership and registers queued state only after initiator acceptance.
The browser displays canonical statuses, logs, and signed evidence without polling.
Only successful artifacts with valid sha256 digests become repository@digest candidates.
Absent mirror plumbing fails closed; no direct private GitHub fetcher is implemented.
Bahia self-dispatch publishes a grasp-compatible durable kind-5401 event, never the ephemeral ContextVM kind 25910, and returns that event id as ci_run_id for subscriber and 5402 lineage correlation.

Exact initiation and subscriber replay do not duplicate the run or dispatch lineage, missing explicit self-issuer trust produces a reasoned warning without changing operator configuration, and unsupported build arguments fail before side effects rather than becoming false provenance.

Each accepted self-issued 5401 submits exactly one kind-5100 job through the control-plane pool and signer with p, method=ci/workflow-run, e/run correlation to ci_run_id, and mirror repository, ref, and workflow parameters; no payment tag is sent.

Hive-CI Loom placement is restricted to trusted workers whose signed kind-10100 advertisement declares workload ci/workflow-run and feature hive_ci_profile, and any supplied secrets remain NIP-44 encrypted to the selected worker.
